name: Hollow Wretch
lore: A small Gateborn husk formed from erased memory. It attacks in groups and leaves cold silence behind when destroyed.
visualDescription: Thin charcoal humanoid shard-body, incomplete mask, white cracks, no faction marks.
mapBehavior: Rushes isolated Titans and punishes careless positioning.

name: Gateborn Colossus
lore: A giant malformed guardian grown around unstable Gate stone. It is not a Titan and has no civilization; it is a defensive catastrophe.
visualDescription: Massive stone-black creature with gateway ribs, glowing fracture-core, many broken arch fragments embedded in its shoulders.
mapBehavior: Controls central objectives and forces Titans to split pressure.

name: Beast Realm Maneater
lore: A predator from a Beast Realm where instinct became law. It is not evil in a human sense; it is a living argument that survival has no court of appeal.
visualDescription: Mythic lion-wolf-serpent predator, bone mane, ember eyes, ancient scars, earth-dark hide, non-sci-fi monster silhouette.
mapBehavior: Tracks wounded Titans and escalates if ignored.

name: Forgotten Standard Bearer
lore: A remnant of a removed civilization whose name cannot be safely spoken. It carries a banner that remembers wars the Codex refuses to restore.
visualDescription: Tall armored remnant with faceless helm, shredded banner of erased sigils, rusted mythic plate, ash falling upward.
mapBehavior: Buffs lesser Hollow enemies and creates denial zones.

name: Ancient World Boss: Leviathan of the First Flood
lore: A catastrophic primordial beast awakened when multiple Gate scars align beneath ancient waters. It is a campaign-scale threat, not a faction unit.
visualDescription: Colossal mythic sea serpent-dragon made of stormwater, basalt scales, drowned temple chains, moonlit eyes, and tidal crown horns.
mapBehavior: Campaign boss encounter that transforms terrain each phase.

name: Hollow Choirling
lore: A small mouthless choir-husk that hums erased prayers until Titan formation timing begins to slip.
visualDescription: Small bent humanoid with a smooth unfinished face, throat full of white fracture lines, ash ribbons floating from its shoulders.
mapBehavior: Stays behind Wretches and applies silence pressure to isolated lanes.

name: Hollow Knell Archer
lore: A long-limbed Hollow marksman grown from remembered executions; every arrow is a moment someone forgot to duck.
visualDescription: Tall charcoal archer with broken crescent bow, mask slit, pale arrow-sparks, ragged funeral cloth.
mapBehavior: Targets Support and Battery Titans from cover, forcing movement.

name: Hollow Oath-Eater
lore: A Gateborn hunger that feeds on promises made under pressure, especially Asgardian vows and Empyrean edicts.
visualDescription: Heavy black beast-knight with ringed jaw, torn rune chains, oath-stone lodged in chest, white crack-teeth.
mapBehavior: Punishes Titans that repeat the same objective action without support.

name: Hollow Sunless Magistrate
lore: A false judge created from stolen Aten Ra law; it issues verdicts that erase context and leave only punishment.
visualDescription: Tall robed absence with bronze-black scales, faceless sun disk cracked in half, floating judgment shards.
mapBehavior: Corrupts capture points and reverses sustain if not interrupted.

name: Hollow Banner Maw
lore: A crawling banner-creature that grew from the Forgotten Standard Bearer’s shadow and devours unit identity.
visualDescription: Low quadruped made of torn banners, bone pole ribs, mouth hidden under cloth, erased sigils crawling over hide.
mapBehavior: Drags nearby swarm units into frenzy when a Titan falls below half health.

name: Hollow Mirror Saint
lore: An Empyrean-shaped absence that reflects protection into imprisonment; it proves order can be imitated without mercy.
visualDescription: Winglike negative-space guardian with broken halo mirror, porcelain mask fragments, chain-light without warmth.
mapBehavior: Creates shield zones that help Hollow units unless shattered by coordinated strikes.

name: Hollow Root Parasite
lore: A rootlike Hollow larva that infects living terrain, making groves remember pain before growth.
visualDescription: Black root-serpent with pale sap cracks, thorn mouth, leafless tendrils, soil clinging upward.
mapBehavior: Occupies natural terrain and makes sustain tiles hazardous until cleansed.

name: Hollow Shrine-Mask
lore: A mask that learned enough shrine etiquette to lure Kami guardians into the wrong ritual path.
visualDescription: Floating lacquer mask cracked open with smoke hands, torn paper wards, ink bleeding upward.
mapBehavior: Repositions around shrine terrain and causes missed timing windows.

name: Hollow Laurel Butcher
lore: A brutal parody of Olympian excellence that treats victory as proof even when the contest is corrupted.
visualDescription: Muscular faceless gladiator silhouette, black marble skin, broken bronze laurel fused to skull, ichorless cracks.
mapBehavior: Challenges highest-attack Titan and gains pressure if ignored.

name: Hollow Chain Auditor
lore: A contract-thing that writes debts no one agreed to, born where Infernal ambition meets Gate erasure.
visualDescription: Bent accountant-devil silhouette made of chains and ledgers, no eyes, burning white contract seams.
mapBehavior: Taxes repeated abilities and punishes greedy burst rotations.

name: Hollow Gate Anchor
lore: A stationary living keystone that lets Hollow waves keep returning until the squad breaks the wound itself.
visualDescription: Obsidian gate-stone torso rooted into battlefield, incomplete arms, white fracture core, broken arch crown.
mapBehavior: Acts as a priority objective; spawns minor Hollow until destroyed.

name: Hollow Memory Thief
lore: A thin assassin that steals the memory of a Titan’s last tactic, forcing the squad to adapt instead of repeat.
visualDescription: Slender black blade-limbed figure, empty face veil, stolen glyphs orbiting its fingers, quiet white eye-cracks.
mapBehavior: Targets repeated player actions and disrupts cooldown rhythm.

name: Hollow World-Wound Behemoth
lore: A massive mobile Gate wound used for seasonal Hollow Breach events; it is not summoned, it arrives where too many victories leave unburied memory.
visualDescription: Colossal negative-space beast with gate arches as ribs, cities of ash under translucent hide, maskless skull horizon, white storm fractures.
mapBehavior: Seasonal world boss that changes terrain, spawns anchors, and tests multiple squad archetypes.
